tei:div.tei:p: "$ (81)༄༅// gling bzhi rgyan gyi maṇḍal bzhugs so/// /

(82)༄༅// shin tu spros pa med par dbang bskur ba'i tshe lnga tshan lnga'i maṇḍal rim pas 'bul zhing*/ nam mkha'i dbyings gang bar dmigs te/ tshig gi rgyal po 'di dag gis gsal bar bya'o// oṃ ā ཿhūm̐/ yid bzhin rin po ches brgyan pa'i zhing khams nor bu sna tshogs kyi sa gzhi la gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/ rin po che sna bdun 'bar ba'i ri dang shing dang skyed mos tshal dang gzhal med khang 'od gsal gyi gnas/ nor bu 'thon ka dang*/ 'thon ka chen po dang*/ ke ke ru dang*/ padma rā ga dang*/ ma rgad ta dang*/ mu sa garbha dang*/ yid bzhin sprin la sogs pa/ sna tshogs 'byor pa'i mnga' thang tshad med pas legs par bkod pa'i gzhi/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas par yid bzhin rin po che'i dra bas yongs su gang bar dmigs te/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rtag par rgyun gyi 'khor lor 'bul lo// yid bzhin (83)rin chen sprin gyi dra bas kun nas brgyan pa'i bla bre can/ dpal ldan 'dod dgu'i char gyi tshogs mang nam mkha'i dbyings kun yongs bkod de/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ji bzhin ting 'dzin rol mo bsam yas kyis// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal du gyur gang kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis mchod// gling bzhi 'jig rten rgyan gyur mchod pa'i sprin// yid bzhin rin chen sna tshogs 'di 'bul bas// 'gro kun gnas skabs 'dod dgu lhun grub cing*// mthar thug ye shes lnga la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yon tan rin po ches brgyan pa'i zhing khams nam mkha'i mkha' klas par sna tshogs rin po ches yongs su bkod pa'i gzhi/ shing dang*/ sman dang*/ me tog dang*/ lo tog yongs su rgyas pa'i 'bru dang*/ 'bras bu'i rngad mang pos legs par 'byor ba 'di nyid bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la srid pa ji srid rnam par grol ba de srid kyi bar du (84)'bul lo// 'bru mang 'byor pa shin tu mtha' yas bsam gtan zas kyi rjes 'gro ba// sman shing lo thog legs smin dul ba'i 'bras bu shin tu rmad byung gis// dpag yas nam mkha'i dbyings kun bkang ste yid bzhin sprin tshogs kyis// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod// 'bru mang sna tshogs dam pas rab brgyan pa// yon tan rin chen yongs gang 'di phul bas// 'gro kun gnas skabs 'byor pa mtha' yas shing*// mthar thug sku lnga'i zhing la spyod par shog

/oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ye shes rin po ches kun tu brgyan pa'i zhing khams dri'i snying po can/ tsandan sna tshogs kyi bsrungs dang*/ sman dang me tog gis dris kun tu khyab pa/ spos kyi shing ljon pa rin po che'i dra bas legs par brgyan zhing dri bzang po mchog tu gyur pa'i chu klung 'bum phrag du ma dal gyis 'bab pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa tshad med pa'i mnga' thang chen pos dbang 'byor pa 'di nyid// bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la/ 'gro ba mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba'i go 'phang la gnas pa de srid du 'bul lo// sman shing me tog dri zhim ngad ldan spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i chu// dwangs shing rnyog bral dri mchog gis khyab nam mkha'i dbyings kun yongs bkod de// dpag med mthu ldan rim rgyas rdul bral rgyal ba'i dri gtsang gis mdzes pa// sna tshogs yon tan 'byor bas yongs gang kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gis mchod// sman dang spos mchog bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin sprin// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur gang legs phul bas// 'gro kun (85)gnas skabs dbang po rab gsal zhing*// mthar thug gdod ma'i gzhi la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yid bzhin sprin gyi zhing khams sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin la/ sman gyi shing ljon pa dpag tu med pas brgyan zhing*/ gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg dang*/ chos thams cad sman gyi phung po tshad med pa'i rang bzhin 'byung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mthu dang ldan pa/ rnam par bkra zhing yid du 'ong ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa'i sprin phung gis 'khrigs pa rang byung bas nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par bkod pa gsal ba can/ rtsa dang shing dang me tog gi sman rnam pa tha dad pa dang*/ sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung dang*/ nam mkha'i bdud rtsis kun tu gang ba 'di nyid/

bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la lus can thams cad thar pa chen po'i grong du phyin pa de srid du rtag par 'bul lo// sna tshogs sman gyi phung pos yongs gang bkra shis gzi byin ldan pa gang*// sa dang nam mkha'i dbyings kun yongs khyab srid gsum bde dge'i gzhir gyur pa/ 'byung dang nyon mongs nad kun zhi byed rnam grol bdud rtsi'i snying po can// ma lus ji snyed ji bzhin bkod pas 'gro ba'i bla ma sras bcas mchod// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nad rab zhi byed pa// sman mchog dam pa gyur pa 'di phul bas// 'gro kun gnas skabs tshe ring nad med cing*// mthar thug bde chen zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'od gsal rin po ches bkod pa'i zhing khams me tog gi skyed mos tshal bkod legs pa'i sa gzhi yid du 'ong ba la/ padma dang*/ padma (86)chen po dang*/ ku mu ta dang*/ utpal dang*/ u dumbā ra'i tshogs la sogs pas rab tu brgyan zhing*/ chu dang thang dang skyed mos tshal las 'thon pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas legs par brgyan pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la nam mkha'i khams dang chos kyi dbyings ji srid gnas pa de srid du rgyas par bkang ste 'bul lo// dpag med chu ldan rab rgyas ge sar mdangs bkra zhing*// mtshor nyal 'dzum pa'i 'od zer dang ldan skyed mos tshal// sna tshogs kha phye lhag ger 'dug pas mdzes gyur pa// nam mkha'i dbyings kun yid kyis bkang ste gus pas mchod// me tog bkod sprin nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pa// dpag yas rin chen dra ba 'di phul bas// 'gro kun gnas skabs shes rab rgya che zhing*// mthar thug 'od lnga'i zhing la spyod par shog /ces dbyangs snyan pos lan gsum gsum du 'bul bar bya'o// tshul 'di ni dbang dang gdams pa gong ma la 'jug pa'i tshe bya ba yin gyi/

tha mal pa'i tshe bya ba ni ma yin no// lan cig phul bas kyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing*/ ye shes nyi shu rtsa lnga la spyod par gsungs so// maṇḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga gling bzhi rgyan gyur zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis bkod pa rdzogs so/// /dge'o/// /
